chunks: Said Iblis: 'Since You led me into error, I shall lie in wait for them along Your straight path.'

key_terms.لَأَقْعُدَنَ: I shall lie in wait / sit in ambush

ai.seo_question: What did Iblis promise to do with Allah's permission?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights Iblis's strategic shift from open rebellion to subtle, persistent temptation, targeting the 'Sirat al-Mustaqim' as the primary route to divine proximity. The phrase 'because of what You made me err' is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as referring to Allah's decree of his misguidance rather than a literal cause, emphasizing human free will in the face of satanic whispers. This sets the stage for the cosmic struggle between guidance and deviation, central to Shia theological understanding of human responsibility.
